meta.title: Contact Dispatch
meta.description: Contact KUL Enterprises. Dispatch is {phone}, answered around the clock. Freight quotes, carrier packet requests and driver enquiries. Based in {location}.

opening.heading: The number is answered.
opening.lede: No phone tree and no ticket queue. Calls go straight to dispatch, any hour.

locationCard.imageAlt: An open highway running toward distant hills
locationCard.heading: {location}

dispatchCard.heading: Call dispatch.
dispatchCard.body: If a load is moving today, this is faster than any form.

routes.heading: Where to send it
routes.intro: All three rows below reach the same inbox, so use whichever fits and say so in the first line.

items.label: Freight quotes
items.body: Origin, destination, freight type and pickup date. Priced the same day where we can.

items.label: Carrier packet
items.body: W-9, certificate of insurance and operating authority for your onboarding file. Asked for here, sent by email.

items.label: Drivers
items.body: Applications are open now, ahead of the seat. Leave your details and you are called when it opens.
